project_type: Python 3.13 FastAPI + Strands Agents backend (backend/) with a React 19 + Vite 8 + TS frontend (frontend/); M4 adds a Python AWS CDK app (infrastructure/)
language: Python (backend, CDK); TypeScript (frontend, unchanged in M4)
build_system: uv-managed venv at heatwise-ai/.venv (NO pip inside: install with `uv pip install --python .venv\Scripts\python.exe <pkg>==<ver>`; uv prints progress on stderr which PowerShell shows as NativeCommandError, so judge by exit code). Frontend: npm in frontend/. CDK: separate venv infrastructure/.venv created with `uv venv infrastructure\.venv --python 3.13`; CLI via `npx --yes aws-cdk@2.1147.0` (never a global install).
test_framework: pytest 9.2.0 (pyproject: testpaths backend/tests, addopts -m 'not live'); moto 5.2.5 for DynamoDB/S3/Lambda mocks; ScriptedModel (backend/agents/scripted.py) + FakeProvider (backend/tests/fakes.py) + demo weather for agents; Vitest for frontend; aws_cdk.assertions + pytest for infrastructure/tests
build_command: frontend: cd frontend; npm run build. Lambda asset: .venv\Scripts\python.exe infrastructure\scripts\build_lambda_asset.py. CDK: cd infrastructure; .\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1; npx --yes aws-cdk@2.1147.0 synth --all
test_command: backend: .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -q (baseline 223 passed, 4 deselected). frontend: cd frontend; npm run typecheck; npm run lint; npm test; npm run build (46 tests). infra: infrastructure\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest infrastructure\tests -q
verification_instructions: 1) backend pytest offline must pass with all 223 old tests plus the new ones (no network, no real AWS/Bedrock: moto only, fake creds AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=testing etc.). 2) frontend typecheck/lint/test/build exit 0. 3) build the Lambda asset and record its unzipped size (< 262,144,000 bytes). 4) infra pytest passes; cdk synth --all exits 0 (HeatWiseData, HeatWiseApi) and with -c heatwise:frontend=true (adds HeatWiseFrontend). 5) Record resources per stack, IAM statements, absence of AWS::ApiGateway::Account, asset size in the FEAT findings.
snapshot_or_generated_files: infrastructure/build/lambda (generated asset, git-ignored), infrastructure/cdk.out (git-ignored), frontend/dist (build output). Frontend test fixtures in frontend/src/test/fixtures are generated by `python -m backend.tests.export_fixtures frontend\src\test\fixtures` - do NOT regenerate them in M4 (the API contract is unchanged).
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell, ~6 GB RAM, Docker often not running: never use Docker or CDK bundling with Docker. Not a git repo: work in place, no commits, no worktree. NEVER create/modify/delete AWS resources: no cdk deploy/destroy/bootstrap, no AWS write calls; read-only calls (sts get-caller-identity, describe/list/get) only if needed. Do not touch existing IAM users/policies/keys/stacks. Setting $env:X="" in PowerShell deletes the variable; use VITE_API_BASE_URL="/" for same-origin builds. Relative paths resolve against d:\github work\SDK workshop\heatwise-ai only if you pass cwd; always use absolute paths or cwd.
contribution_requirements: Pin every new dependency exactly (Python and npm, incl. aws-cdk-lib, constructs, CDK CLI via npx@version). No secrets/credentials in code or config; model id, region, table names from env/config. Do not break existing 223 backend and 46 frontend tests. Automated tests never call real AWS or Bedrock. Keep the frontend API contract unchanged (JobView fields, AssessmentRequest keys {place, forecast_days, profile}, status codes). No em dashes in AWS resource names/descriptions. Keep the spec (.kiro/specs/heatwise-ai/requirements.md, design.md, tasks.md) in sync. Plain, factual docs; no invented numbers or prices.
key_patterns: Settings in backend/config.py (pydantic-settings, env names = upper-case field names, tests construct Settings(_env_file=None, ...)). create_app(settings, store, coordinator_factory) DI factory in backend/api/app.py; routes read app.state.{settings,store,jobs}. Error envelope in backend/api/errors.py (TooManyJobs -> 429). AssessmentStore ABC in backend/session/store.py with 32-hex report ids. Coordinator builds a fresh Agent per run (_build_agent) with hooks + OrderingSteeringHandler + SequentialToolExecutor; AGENT_NAME='coordinator'. Tests reuse test_coordinator.build()/calls()/DELEGATIONS, test_store.record(), test_cli.scripted_report(). Strands 1.63.0: FileSessionManager(session_id, storage_dir), S3SessionManager(session_id, bucket, prefix, region_name=...), Agent(agent_id=..., session_manager=...); constructing a session manager immediately reads/creates the session.
directory_structure: d:\github work\SDK workshop\heatwise-ai: backend/{agents, api, models, services, guidance, session, skills, tools, tests, config.py, cli.py, main.py}, frontend/ (Vite app), new infrastructure/ (app.py, cdk.json, stacks/, scripts/, tests/, requirements*.txt, lambda-requirements.txt), new docs/ (deployment.md, architecture.md). Stored records in .data/assessments (git-ignored .data/). Spec in d:\github work\SDK workshop\.kiro\specs\heatwise-ai\.
